name: CANDY TOYS
source:
Touya Kamishiro is a skilled programmer. However, his work consisted almost entirely of illegal activities bordering on hacking.

One day, a program he created on a whim was adopted as the official operating system for a major corporation, and he suddenly found himself with an unexpected windfall.
Touya used the money to buy a house and an apartment to serve as his office, but he was still at a loss as to what to do with the money he still had to spare.

“I’m in such good health it’s almost ridiculous, and I have no interest in drinking or gambling… So that leaves women.”
“But love and romance just aren’t my thing—I’m not cut out for that…” Taya thought.

Then he came up with a plan. It involved having someone else—in exchange for taking over their debt—provide a girl who would stay with him for a month to perform “work”… The plan proceeded smoothly, and a few days later, a girl was sitting in a bowing position before Touya, looking bewildered.
This was Kanata Misakura, the girl who would be doing “work” to pay off her family’s debt.

A trivial incident and a small desire brought these two together.
Just what kind of month will they end up spending together?

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150903004157/http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/candytoys]official site[/url]]
